# Agent Plugin Type

## Rules
- `AgentPlugin extends SpecdPlugin`: `type:'agent'`; `install(config: SpecdConfig, options?: AgentInstallOptions): Promise<AgentInstallResult>`; `uninstall(config, options?): Promise<void>`. Config is full project config.
- Options: `skills?:string[]`, `agents?:string[]`, recursive `variables?:Record<string,TemplateVariable>`, `capabilities?:string[]`; omit selectors = all. Initial capability IDs: `mcp`, `agents`, `frontmatter` (MCP branches, delegated-agent branches, compose `variables.frontmatter`).
- Pass frontmatter data only at `variables.frontmatter`, never prebuilt YAML. `variables.sharedFolder` is project-root-relative; `@specd/skills` normalizes/validates it. Capabilities are plain IDs, never normalized objects.
- Result: `{installed:Array<{skill,path}>, skipped:Array<{skill,reason}>}`. Install target follows runtime convention; without `agents`, copy agent template beside `shared.md`.
- Export domain-pure `isAgentPlugin(value: SpecdPlugin): value is AgentPlugin`: type `agent`, functional `install`, functional `uninstall`.

## Constraints
- Agent plugins specialize base plugin; install capability data separate from variables.
